elements.description: A conversation transcript to annotate: label spans, redact, rate turns, correct answers and send the example on.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the transcript's accessible name

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quieter line under the heading – where the conversation came from

properties.name: labels
properties.default: [ { id: "incorrect", label: "Incorrect", tone: "rose", description: "States something that isn't true" }, { id: "unsupported", label: "Unsupported", tone: "amber", description: "Not backed by anything it was given" }, { id: "sensitive", label: "Sensitive", tone: "violet", description: "Personal or confidential information" }, { id: "helpful", label: "Helpful", tone: "teal", description: "A good example of what we want" }, ]
properties.description: The label set; the first nine get the shortcut keys 1–9

properties.name: value
properties.description: Spans, ratings and corrections. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: ratingLevels
properties.default: [ { value: 1, label: "Poor" }, { value: 2, label: "Okay" }, { value: 3, label: "Good" }, ]
properties.description: The rating scale for a turn, lowest first

properties.name: rateRoles
properties.description: The roles whose turns can be rated

properties.name: correctRoles
properties.description: The roles whose turns can be corrected

properties.name: roleLabels
properties.description: Display names per role; an unknown role shows as written

properties.name: sending
properties.description: The app is sending the example: the button shows it's busy

properties.name: sent
properties.description: The app has stored the example: the button reads "Sent to dataset" until the value changes

properties.name: name
properties.description: Submitted with the form: the value as JSON

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Turns every control off and leaves the value out of the form; a disabled fieldset does the same

properties.name: example
properties.description: The export copy tc-send carries: redacted text replaced by █

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: A span, rating or correction changed ({ value }: ConversationAnnotationValueChange); cancelable – prevent it to control `value`

events.name: tc-send
events.description: "Send to dataset" was pressed ({ value, example }: ConversationAnnotationSend) – `example` has redacted text blanked out

functions.name: annotationMatchesSource
functions.signature: annotationMatchesSource(span: AnnotationSpan, messages: readonly AnnotationMessage[]): void
functions.description: The span still points at the same text in its message

functions.name: prepareAnnotationExport
functions.signature: prepareAnnotationExport(messages: readonly AnnotationMessage[], value: ConversationAnnotationValue): AnnotationExport
functions.description: An export copy: redacted spans become █ in the messages, in every quote that overlaps them and in corrections

props.name: value
props.description: Spans, ratings and corrections. Controlled when defined; otherwise the component keeps them, starting from `defaultValue`

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value at first when `value` isn't controlled

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole value after every label, redaction, rating or correction, controlled or not

props.name: onSend
props.description: Called when "Send to dataset" is pressed, with the value and the export copy whose redacted text is blanked out
